pages.title: The sandbox
pages.body: The plugin reads only its own folder, so fileable is **vendored** next to it.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.body: Run `node examples/fileable/vendor.mjs`, then build with `--allow-plugin fileable`.

pages.title: Limits
pages.body: No `cmd`, no local `src=` paths, no `env://`: they need what a plugin does not get.
